name: Excess-attention EXTREME fade — short the far-tail talk-with-no-money spike (1d)
rationale: MECHANISM: the excess-attention continuation is positive across the bulk of the distribution, but at the FAR extreme (excess_attention_z well above the continuation zone) the loud-talk-no-money reading flips meaning: it is a manufactured/euphoric spike with no flow behind it, a set-up for a fade rather than continuation. This variant is the SHORT sign at the tail — distinct in both sign and regime from the excess-attention long. Confirm with an overbought RSI so we fade a stretched top, not mid-range noise. Counterparty is late chasers buying the hype. DISCONFIRMER: this is the risky opposite of the strongest long finding — the fade must show a robustly NEGATIVE forward return specifically in the far-tail bucket and NOT be explained by RSI-overbought alone (control for rsi). If the long-continuation zone bleeds into the short zone with no clean flip, the two-sided story is overfit, KILL. Short funding/borrow costs must be cleared (funding leg wired).
catalyst: a far-extreme talk-with-no-money spike into overbought — euphoric fade
